project.description: Build and tag the PIC-SURE Dictionary API container images (avillach/dictionary-api, avillach/dictionary-dump) from the shared "PIC-SURE Maven Build" reactor workspace. This job does not compile. If dictionary-db has never been created, this job bootstraps it (one-time); otherwise deploy is exclusively via Stop/Start PIC-SURE.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e trap 'rm -f "$DICT_DIR/.env"' EXIT
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build" DICT_DIR="$MAVEN_WS/services/picsure-dictionary" CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config/dictionary"
if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] \ || ! ls "$DICT_DIR"/target/dictionary-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1 \ || ! ls "$DICT_DIR"/aggregate/target/dump-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts found -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" if [ "${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-}" != "$pipeline_build_id" ]; then echo "ERROR: reactor artifacts belong to pipeline '${PIPELINE_BUILD_ID:-unknown}', expected '$pipeline_build_id'" exit 2 fi
mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR" mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR/db/data" cp "$DICT_DIR/db/schema.sql" "$CONFIG_DIR/db/schema.sql"
# env-file cascade (uploaded param > existing config > generated default) if [ -f dictionary.env ]; then echo "A new dictionary.env was loaded." cp dictionary.env "$CONFIG_DIR/dictionary.env" elif [ -f "$CONFIG_DIR/dictionary.env" ]; then echo "Using existing dictionary.env" else echo "Creating new dictionary.env file." POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$(tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 </dev/urandom | head -c 24) { echo "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" echo "POSTGRES_USER=picsure" echo "POSTGRES_DB=dictionary" echo "POSTGRES_HOST=dictionary-db" echo "PICSURE_ACTUATOR_EXPOSURE=health" } > "$CONFIG_DIR/dictionary.env" fi
# Build/tag only (compose no longer builds). start-picsure.sh runs the # containers from these tags. docker build -t avillach/dictionary-api:latest "$DICT_DIR" docker tag avillach/dictionary-api:latest "avillach/dictionary-api:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" docker build -t avillach/dictionary-dump:latest "$DICT_DIR/aggregate" docker tag avillach/dictionary-dump:latest "avillach/dictionary-dump:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}"
# Bootstrap dictionary-db if it has never been created: start-picsure.sh only # does `docker start dictionary-db`, so first creation must happen here. if ! docker ps -a --filter "name=dictionary-db" --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "^dictionary-db$"; then echo "dictionary-db does not exist yet; creating it via compose (no build, db service only)." cd "$DICT_DIR" cp "$CONFIG_DIR/dictionary.env" .env docker compose up -d --no-build dictionary-db rm -f .env else echo "dictionary-db already exists; leaving it to Stop/Start PIC-SURE." fi
